[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Data.String
import Data.List

def implementation (numbers: String) : String :=
  let words := numbers.splitOn " "
  let numbers_map := words.map word_to_number_map
  let sorted_numbers := numbers_map.sort
  let sorted_words := sorted_numbers.map number_to_word
  " "++.foldr (fun w acc => w++" "++acc) "" sorted_words

number_to_word (n : Int) : String :=
  match n with
  | 0 => "zero"
  | 1 => "one"
  | 2 => "two"
  | 3 => "three"
  | 4 => "four"
  | 5 => "five"
  | 6 => "six"
  | 7 => "seven"
  | 8 => "eight"
  | 9 => "nine"
  | _ => ""

word_to_number_map (word : String) : Int :=
  match word with
  | "zero" => 0
  | "one" => 1
  | "two" => 2
  | "three" => 3
  | "four" => 4
  | "five" => 5
  | "six" => 6
  | "seven" => 7
  | "eight" => 8
  | "nine" => 9
  | _ => -1

[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma word_to_number_map_correct
(word : String) :
word_to_number_map word = match word with
| "zero" => 0
| "one" => 1
| "two" => 2
| "three" => 3
| "four" => 4
| "five" => 5
| "six" => 6
| "seven" => 7
| "eight" => 8
| "nine" => 9
| _ => -1
:= by
cases word
refl

lemma number_to_word_correct
(n : Int) :
number_to_word n = match n with
| 0 => "zero"
| 1 => "one"
| 2 => "two"
| 3 => "three"
| 4 => "four"
| 5 => "five"
| 6 => "six"
| 7 => "seven"
| 8 => "eight"
| 9 => "nine"
| _ => ""
:= by
cases n
refl

lemma split_on_correct
(s : String) (sep : Char) :
s.splitOn sep = List.ofArray (s.toArray.map (fun c => String.ofChar c).splitOn String.mk sep).map String.ofArray
:= by
induction s generalizing sep
  case nil : s => rfl
  case cons : s head tail sep =>
    simp [split_on]
    simp [head, tail, split_on_correct tail sep]

lemma foldr_correct
(f : α → β → β) (init : β) (l : List α) :
foldr f init l = l.foldr f init
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [foldr, tail.foldr]

lemma map_correct
(f : α → β) (l : List α) :
l.map f = List.map f l
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [map, tail.map f]

lemma sort_correct
(l : List Int) :
l.sort = List.sort l
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [sort, tail.sort]

lemma concat_correct
(l : List String) :
" "++.foldr (fun w acc => w++" "++acc) "" l = String.concat l
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [concat, foldr, tail.concat]

lemma length_correct
(l : List α) :
l.length = List.length l
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [length, tail.length]

lemma count_correct
(l : List α) (a : α) :
l.count a = List.count a l
:= by
induction l
  case nil : l =>
    rfl
  case cons : head tail =>
    simp [count, tail.count]

[END]
